release_steps: git tag vX.Y.Z; git push origin HEAD vX.Y.Z

ci.pin: PySide6>=6.5,<6.9 (install from requirements.txt; job rejects anything outside that range)
ci.stdin: /dev/null on every suite so ffmpeg cannot SIGTTIN on an inherited tty or block on an open stdin
ci.ffmpeg: imageio-ffmpeg binary; if libaom-av1, libx264, libvpx, or libvpx-vp9 is missing, apt install ffmpeg and set IMAGEIO_FFMPEG_EXE. The export skip path is a failed check, so 40 is not a pass.
ci.why_not_windows: ubuntu-latest already passes all 7 offscreen and is the fast path. windows-latest remains release.yml only so PRs do not repeat the PySide6+OpenCV install.
ci.result_grep: grep -a. smoke_test_export prints a NUL inside an APNG tEXt extra, so plain grep treats the log as binary and hides the 결과 line.

first_green.ffmpeg: imageio-ffmpeg bundle, libaom-av1 present, distro ffmpeg not installed

recorder_frame.lock_reason: Frames in one take must share a size. Moving during the take also shifts the picture. Stop returns to idle, which can move and resize again.
recorder_frame.windows_hit_test: WM_NCHITTEST. Move is HTCAPTION, resize is HTLEFT and the other HT codes, the capture hole is HTTRANSPARENT. Physical pixels convert with each monitor's native origin and devicePixelRatio.
recorder_frame.other_platforms: QWindow.startSystemMove and startSystemResize, then manual drag. Offscreen and minimal platforms use manual drag only.
recorder_frame.capture_api: capture_rect() is still the transparent hole. Chrome sits outside it.
recorder_frame.preset_index: Recorder PRESETS order is unchanged, so the record-page combo index still matches through 1280x720. 1920x1080 is index 6 on the capture window only.
recorder_frame.windows_status: Smoke-launched on Windows only. The owner has not confirmed the UX. PR #19 body records Linux offscreen 120/120 62/62 40/40 15/15 42/42 10/10 33/33.
